metadata.scenario_context: The school is hosting an academic discussion about immigration. Mike, Kim, and Emily are planning to meet at a set time to attend the event together.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that immigration increases the crime rate.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Libya strongly agree that immigration increases the crime rate.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss asking Emily to join at the agreed-upon time.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the belief that how immigration impacts social security.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the time to meet and attend the event together.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss how immigration impacts social security.
